EO Smart Guard Pro v1.0 Even/Odd automated bot for Deriv DBot.
Market: Volatility 100 (1s) Index - change SYMBOL_LIST field to trade another synthetic index. Editable inputs live in the INITIALIZATION section of the Trade Definition block: initial stake, multiplier, max stake, daily profit target, daily stop loss, max consecutive losses, max trades per session, trade direction (EVEN / ODD / RANDOM).
Risk management: bot automatically stops (sets isTradingAllowed = false) once ANY limit is reached: daily profit target, daily stop loss, max consecutive losses, or max trades per session.

block.comment: Market / contract setup. To switch markets, edit SYMBOL_LIST below (e.g. R_100, 1HZ75V, R_50_1S).
Set to EVEN, ODD, or RANDOM (case sensitive)
Runs before every trade. Only purchases if all risk-management limits still allow trading, then applies the selected direction (EVEN / ODD / RANDOM).

block.field: Bot stopped before entry - a risk limit was already reached. Total P/L:

block.comment: Runs after each contract settles. Updates dashboard stats, applies win/reset or loss/multiplier stake logic, then re-checks all stop conditions.

block.field: WIN - stake reset to initial. Profit this trade:

block.comment: Apply multiplier, capped at max stake
Final stop check - re-evaluated after every trade

block.field: BOT STOPPED - risk limit reached. Final P/L:
